changes: org.freedesktop.Platform.GL.aurora for the Freedesktop 25.08 and 26.08 runtimes: Aurora's Mesa (the same commit as the host mesa) built with flatpak-builder as alarm-aurora builds it, in a local OSTree repository that the package installs into the system Flatpak installation and enables ahead of Flathub's GL.default.
notes: Its source is the Mesa archive pinned for mesa-aurora (the extension's Mesa module builds from it); the packaging is alarm-aurora's recipe. The build installs the aarch64 Freedesktop runtimes, SDK and LLVM 22 SDK extension from Flathub and fetches the manifest's pinned sources, as alarm-aurora's does.
